description: Defines enums and structs related to gateway connection errors, including authentication error codes, recovery steps, and error handling structures for gateway responses.

classes.name: GatewayConnectAuthError
classes.description: Represents structured websocket connect-auth rejection errors with detailed info and logic for recoverability.

classes.name: GatewayResponseError
classes.description: Represents errors when the gateway responds with a failure status.

classes.name: GatewayDecodingError
classes.description: Represents errors during decoding of gateway responses.

methods.name: GatewayConnectAuthError.init
methods.description: Initializes an auth error with message, detail code, retry info, and optional next step.

methods.name: GatewayResponseError.init
methods.description: Initializes a response error with method, code, message, and details.

methods.name: GatewayDecodingError.init
methods.description: Initializes a decoding error with method and message.
